summary: This resolution elects 14 Democratic members including Mr. Doggett and Mr. Scott to the House Budget Committee, 4 including Mr. Morelle to the House Administration Committee, 4 including Ms. Velázquez to the Natural Resources Committee, and 2 including Ms. Pressley to the Oversight and Government Reform Committee.

scores.thoughts: This resolution only appoints members to the House Budget Committee and other panels. It contains no provisions that authorize, increase, decrease, or restructure any government spending programs or appropriations.
The bill is strictly procedural and makes no changes to tax law, rates, credits, or enforcement.
No healthcare policy, funding, regulation, or coverage provisions appear in the text.
The resolution does not address firearms, regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
No immigration, border, or visa-related content is present.
The bill contains nothing related to reproductive rights or abortion access.
No military, defense authorization, or spending language exists in the resolution.
Although members are appointed to the Natural Resources Committee, the resolution itself makes no environmental policy changes.
No welfare, entitlement, or social program provisions are included.
The text does not engage with education funding, policy, or school choice.
No drug enforcement, decriminalization, or related measures are addressed.
The resolution contains no criminal justice, sentencing, or policing provisions.
No trade agreements, tariffs, or globalization measures are present.
Although the Budget Committee is mentioned, the bill does not alter debt limits, deficits, or fiscal targets.
The resolution does not address LGBTQ+ legal protections or rights.
No foreign aid, international assistance, or State Department funding language appears.
Members are appointed to the House Administration Committee, which oversees elections, but the resolution itself makes no changes to voting access, election integrity, or related rules.
No technology regulation, data privacy, or platform oversight provisions exist.
The bill does not address labor law, union rights, or workplace regulations.
No religious liberty, civil rights, or anti-discrimination measures are included.
